_readme:
Writes data/outside/2026_w11_footballers.json and 2026_w11_sharp.json: the Week 11 outside-source tables, transcribed from
the pasted articles (The Fantasy Footballers' tournament-takes ownership notes and DraftKings optimizer view; Sharp Football's
Worksheet and core / tournament plays). Run `python -m scripts.import_outside_w11` to regenerate.

Footballers records: set "a" = the ownership-notes tables (pOwn and projection, top players per position) and set "b" = the
optimizer view (salary, projection, ceiling, projected ownership, players over $4,000 with a projection). Sharp has no
projection numbers or ownership, only calls: core and tournament plays and role notes, kept as text.

notes.name: Dak Prescott
notes.note: Trust. Four straight top-10 weeks; Titans allow QB1 weeks in 5 of 6 and are last in pressure rate.

notes.name: Patrick Mahomes
notes.note: Trust. Under center at a career-high rate; Arizona is crushed by play action.

notes.name: Cam Ward
notes.note: Trust. QB4 and QB12 the last two weeks on league-high no-huddle and neutral pace; Dallas is last in passing points allowed.

notes.name: Bo Nix
notes.note: Three straight QB1 weeks; Raiders allow the most passing points over eight weeks.

notes.name: Caleb Williams
notes.note: QB1 with upside: Bears' highest implied total of his career (30.25).

notes.name: Josh Allen
notes.note: Surefire QB1, but his spike weeks come when pushed; a 16.5-point favorite may not push. Pricey to pay for.

notes.name: Jared Goff
notes.note: Fringe QB1 against a Bucs defense that is third in passing points allowed.

notes.name: Emmett Johnson
notes.note: Trust. 87% of snaps, 28 touches, 171 yards last week; Walker held out again.

notes.name: Jonah Coleman
notes.note: Controls the backfield, ahead of Dobbins on routes (24 to 4); Raiders allow the most yards per touch to backs.

notes.name: Tony Pollard
notes.note: Trust. Three straight top-10 weeks; 77% of backfield touches with Spears back; Dallas allows the most RB touchdowns (16).

notes.name: James Cook III
notes.note: Eight straight games with a rushing TD; Miami lost its interior linemen.

notes.name: Bucky Irving
notes.note: 100 yards and a TD in four of five; run-heavy Bucs, but a road underdog.

notes.name: Javonte Williams
notes.note: League-high 22 opportunities inside the 5; pivot off the Dallas passing game.

notes.name: Omarion Hampton
notes.note: Career-high 22 carries last week; Jets allow 115.8 rushing yards per game to backs (31st).

notes.name: D'Andre Swift
notes.note: RB2 if Monangai returns: 72.5% of backfield touches over five games without him, 53% with him.

notes.name: Kyle Monangai
notes.note: Expected back from the bye; RB2/RB3 line. Both Bears backs depend on touchdowns.

notes.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
notes.note: RB1 with a high ceiling at home, but Tampa is a tough run matchup (third-fewest yards per touch).

notes.name: Chuba Hubbard
notes.note: Fringe RB1; Brooks is expected back, which trims his 84% of backfield touches.

notes.name: CeeDee Lamb
notes.note: Trust. Double-digit targets in five straight; second in the NFL in points against Cover 4.

notes.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
notes.note: Trust. 20+ PPR points in all four career games against the Bucs; 3.05 yards per route against the blitz.

notes.name: Luther Burden III
notes.note: WR6-WR8 in four straight; leads the team against Cover 3, which New Orleans plays 42.7% of the time.

notes.name: Carnell Tate
notes.note: Hopeful he returns; high-end WR2 if he does. Joey Porter Jr. may follow him but teams avoid Porter.

notes.name: George Pickens
notes.note: Trust. 11-145-3 last week; Titans are flooded by outside receivers.

notes.name: Malik Nabers
notes.note: 28.9% target share and 2.58 yards per route with McCarthy; fringe WR1.

notes.name: Garrett Wilson
notes.note: 35-39% target shares the last two games; Cooper out; Chargers 28th in points per target allowed.

notes.name: Elic Ayomanor
notes.note: 90.7% route rate, 27% of targets; WR3/FLEX with end-zone targets.

notes.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
notes.note: 11 targets last week; 42.9% of his red-zone routes targeted.

notes.name: Jordyn Tyson
notes.note: WR3: route rate jumped from 35% to 72%, 41.9% targeted per route, but air yards per target only 5.3.

notes.name: Chris Olave
notes.note: WR2 rather than a locked WR1: target share fell to 12% last week with Tyson soaking up short targets.

notes.name: Rome Odunze
notes.note: Upside WR2/WR3 as the Bears' third target; 35.7% air-yard share.

notes.name: Colston Loveland
notes.note: TE5 in expected points since Williams returned; 25.8% of the targets over four games.

notes.name: Mark Andrews
notes.note: 8-8-82 with Brissett; fringe TE1, but the target jump needs to stick.

notes.name: Mason Taylor
notes.note: Chargers allow a league-high 9.3 yards per target to tight ends; Cooper and Williams out.

notes.name: Kenyon Sadiq
notes.note: Preferred over Taylor: more slot work and a 20.6% target rate per route.

notes.name: Dawson Knox
notes.note: Kincaid doubtful; Miami allows an 83.3% catch rate to tight ends.

notes.name: Gunnar Helm
notes.note: Cheap attachment to the most popular game; only 51% of dropbacks, so a matchup TE2.

notes.name: Isaiah Likely
notes.note: TE1, but a tougher ceiling spot: the Jaguars allow the fewest yards per target to tight ends.

notes.name: Trey McBride
notes.note: Floor-based TE1: route count fell to 20; the ceiling is lowered by the quarterback change.

notes.name: Brock Bowers
notes.note: Left last week's game after 11 snaps and is expected to miss time.
